## Description {#details}

<p>A GCStrategy which serves as an example for the usage of a statepoint based lowering strategy.</p>


<p>This GCStrategy is intended to suitable as a default implementation usable with any collector which can consume the standard stackmap format generated by statepoints, uses the default addrespace to distinguish between gc managed and non-gc managed pointers, and has reasonable relocation semantics.</p>
